Avoid chasing broad indexes; focus on high-conviction single-stock entries.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's accelerated renewable energy targets (23% by 2025) drive structural demand for solar, wind, and geothermal project developers and equipment suppliers.

US-listed renewable operators with Indonesian exposure benefit from lower financing costs and technology transfer, widening their competitive moat against local peers.
sectors.ai: Buy CSAP and AWK on relative strength; both show resilient demand for water infrastructure and clean power. Trim PCG on regulatory overhang. The sector's slight underperformance vs US peers is a tactical entry point into Indonesia's growing renewable mandates and climate adaptation spending.

Protein and food security trends underpin long-term demand for beef and poultry, as seen in BEEF (+10.00%) and NTBK (+10.00%), supported by government self-sufficiency policies.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's consumer sector shows mixed signals with a 0.94% aggregate gain, but the US's 2.20% rise suggests global tailwinds. Focus on high-momentum movers like KOBX (+33.78%) and AGAR (+24.75%) for short-term plays, but maintain a WATCH stance due to domestic volatility. Prioritize companies with strong earnings visibility and local demand resilience, as the sector's structural growth remains intact despite near-term noise.
